<a id="goldmrrmonthly"></a>

### `gold.mrr_monthly`

Monthly recurring revenue and its movements, one row per calendar month from the first subscription to the month of the newest data. The last row is a month still in progress.

**Context:** [Cross-cutting rules](../context/concepts/cross-cutting-rules.md), [Monthly recurring revenue](../context/concepts/mrr.md)

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `month` | Primary key. First day of the calendar month. |
| `starting_mrr_usd` | Recurring revenue in US dollars at the end of the previous month. Zero for the first month. |
| `new_mrr_usd` | Monthly recurring revenue in US dollars of subscriptions that started during the month. |
| `churned_mrr_usd` | Monthly recurring revenue in US dollars of subscriptions that ended during the month. |
| `ending_mrr_usd` | Recurring revenue in US dollars of subscriptions in force on the last day of the month, or on the newest data day for the month in progress. |

<a id="goldactivecustomermonthly"></a>

### `gold.active_customer_monthly`

Number of active customers at the end of each calendar month, one row per month from the first subscription to the month of the newest data.

**Context:** [Active customer](../context/concepts/active-customer.md)

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `month` | Primary key. First day of the calendar month. |
| `active_customers` | Number of distinct companies with at least one subscription in force and already paid at least once on the last day of the month, or on the newest data day for the month in progress. |
| `active_subscriptions` | Number of subscriptions in force and already paid at least once on the same day. Always at least active_customers. |

<a id="goldfunnelstagemonthly"></a>

### `gold.funnel_stage_monthly`

Number and value of deals that entered each stage of the sales funnel in each calendar month. A stage with no entries in a month has no row.

**Context:** [Funnel stages](../context/concepts/funnel-stages.md)

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `month_stage_key` | Primary key. The month and the stage joined with a bar, for example 2026-01-01\|discovery. |
| `month` | First day of the calendar month in which the deals entered the stage. |
| `stage` | Funnel stage as stored by the CRM. |
| `stage_order` | Position of the stage in the funnel, 1 for qualification to 6 for closed_lost, for sorting. |
| `deals_entered` | Number of distinct deals that entered the stage during the month, according to the stage dates recorded by the CRM. |
| `amount_usd_entered` | Sum in US dollars of the yearly contract value of those deals. |

<a id="goldfunnelconversionmonthly"></a>

### `gold.funnel_conversion_monthly`

Funnel conversion by cohort, one row per calendar month in which deals entered qualification. Each row follows the deals of that cohort and counts how many ever reached each later stage, so recent cohorts are still maturing.

**Context:** [Funnel stages](../context/concepts/funnel-stages.md)

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `cohort_month` | Primary key. First day of the calendar month in which the deals entered qualification. |
| `deals_qualified` | Number of deals that entered qualification during the month. |
| `reached_discovery` | Number of those deals that have entered discovery, whenever it happened. |
| `reached_proposal` | Number of those deals that have entered proposal. |
| `reached_negotiation` | Number of those deals that have entered negotiation. |
| `closed_won` | Number of those deals that have entered closed_won. |
| `closed_lost` | Number of those deals that have entered closed_lost. |
| `still_open` | Number of those deals that have neither closed_won nor closed_lost. |

<a id="goldmqlmonthly"></a>

### `gold.mql_monthly`

Marketing qualified leads counted the way Marketing counts them and the way Sales counts them, one row per calendar month in which a form was submitted.

**Context:** [Marketing qualified lead](../context/concepts/mql.md)

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `month` | Primary key. First day of the calendar month in which the forms were submitted. |
| `form_submissions` | Number of marketing forms submitted during the month. |
| `marketing_mqls` | Number of those submissions that Marketing flagged as a marketing qualified lead. |
| `sales_mqls` | Number of those submissions whose contact Sales flagged as a marketing qualified lead. |
| `conflicting_flags` | Number of those submissions where the Marketing flag and the Sales flag disagree. |

<a id="golddataqualitysnapshot"></a>

### `gold.data_quality_snapshot`

One row with the number of records that carry each data-quality flag, as of the newest daily export. It exposes counts only; the flagged records themselves stay in silver.

**Context:** [Cross-cutting rules](../context/concepts/cross-cutting-rules.md)

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `as_of` | Primary key. Date of the newest daily export loaded. |
| `companies` | Number of company records, duplicates included. |
| `possible_duplicate_companies` | Number of company records whose name matches another record's name, ignoring letter case. Both records of a pair are counted. |
| `deals` | Number of deals, whatever their stage. |
| `deals_without_company` | Number of deals the CRM holds with no company attached. |
| `subscriptions` | Number of subscriptions, whatever their status. |
| `subscriptions_without_deal` | Number of subscriptions whose deal is not in the CRM. |
| `closed_won_deals` | Number of deals in the closed_won stage. |
| `closed_won_without_subscription` | Number of closed_won deals that no subscription points to. It includes deals won in the last two weeks, because a subscription starts within two weeks of the win. |

<a id="silverowner"></a>

### `silver.owner`

One row per person who owns accounts or work in a Fernway team. Latest version from bronze.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `owner_id` | Primary key. Identifier of the owner in the CRM. |
| `full_name` | Owner's full name (fictional). |
| `email` | Owner's e-mail, always on the reserved example.com domain. |
| `team` | Team the owner belongs to (sdr, sales, enterprise, onboarding or customer_success). |
| `last_seen_batch_id` | Bronze batch (as_of=date) this version of the row came from. |

<a id="silvercompany"></a>

### `silver.company`

One row per company record in the CRM, latest version from bronze. May contain the same real-world company twice; see is_possible_duplicate.

**Context:** [Active customer](../context/concepts/active-customer.md), [Cross-cutting rules](../context/concepts/cross-cutting-rules.md)

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `company_id` | Primary key. Identifier of the company record in the CRM. |
| `name` | Company name as typed in the CRM. |
| `industry` | Industry the company works in. |
| `segment` | Size segment (smb, mid_market or enterprise), tied to employee_count. |
| `employee_count` | Number of employees. |
| `country` | Two-letter country code. |
| `owner_id` | Owner of the account. Refers to owner.owner_id. |
| `created_at` | Date the company record was created. |
| `is_possible_duplicate` | True when another company record has the same name ignoring letter case. Flagged, never removed; which record is canonical is a business rule. |
| `last_seen_batch_id` | Bronze batch (as_of=date) this version of the row came from. |

<a id="silverdeal"></a>

### `silver.deal`

One row per sales opportunity, latest version from bronze, so stage and closed_at show the most recent state.

**Context:** [Active customer](../context/concepts/active-customer.md), [Cross-cutting rules](../context/concepts/cross-cutting-rules.md), [Funnel stages](../context/concepts/funnel-stages.md), [Monthly recurring revenue](../context/concepts/mrr.md)

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `deal_id` | Primary key. Identifier of the deal in the CRM. |
| `company_id` | Company the deal is with. Empty when the CRM has no company on the deal; see has_company. |
| `has_company` | False when the deal has no company association. |
| `owner_id` | Owner of the deal. Refers to owner.owner_id. |
| `name` | Deal name. |
| `amount_usd` | Yearly contract value in US dollars. |
| `stage` | Current stage of the deal as stored by the CRM. Meaning of each stage is defined in the funnel-stages context document. |
| `created_at` | Date the deal was created. |
| `closed_at` | Date the deal was won or lost. Empty while the deal is open. |
| `last_seen_batch_id` | Bronze batch (as_of=date) this version of the row came from. |

<a id="silverdealstagehistory"></a>

### `silver.deal_stage_history`

One row each time a deal entered a stage, latest version from bronze. Dates can be out of order for some deals (data-quality issue).

**Context:** [Cross-cutting rules](../context/concepts/cross-cutting-rules.md), [Funnel stages](../context/concepts/funnel-stages.md)

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `history_id` | Primary key. Identifier of the history entry. |
| `deal_id` | Deal the entry belongs to. Refers to deal.deal_id. |
| `stage` | Stage the deal entered. |
| `entered_at` | Date the deal entered the stage, as recorded by the CRM. |
| `last_seen_batch_id` | Bronze batch (as_of=date) this version of the row came from. |

<a id="silversubscription"></a>

### `silver.subscription`

One row per paid subscription in billing, latest version from bronze, so status and ended_at show the most recent state.

**Context:** [Active customer](../context/concepts/active-customer.md), [Cross-cutting rules](../context/concepts/cross-cutting-rules.md), [Monthly recurring revenue](../context/concepts/mrr.md)

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `subscription_id` | Primary key. Identifier of the subscription. |
| `deal_id` | Deal the subscription claims to come from. May point to a deal the CRM does not have; see has_matching_deal. |
| `has_matching_deal` | False when no deal with this deal_id exists in the CRM. |
| `company_id` | Company that pays. Refers to company.company_id. |
| `plan` | Plan sold (starter, growth or scale). |
| `mrr_usd` | Monthly recurring revenue of the subscription in US dollars. |
| `status` | Subscription status, active or churned. |
| `started_at` | Date the subscription started. |
| `ended_at` | Date the subscription ended. Empty while it is active. |
| `last_seen_batch_id` | Bronze batch (as_of=date) this version of the row came from. |
